How it works
Read the full production note →
  1. GuardsOrigin check, rate and size limits, before any model sees the question.
  2. PlanGPT splits the question into topics and searches each one separately.
  3. FilterOne yes-or-no per article, judged on its title and summary. Most fall away.
  4. RankSurvivors are scored 0–3. The best three go on.
  5. ReadOnly the relevant sections come back, with the full outline.
  6. AnswerIn my voice, citing the articles as [1], [2].
  7. CheckOnly sources the server actually sent can become links.

What it won't doInvent a project, skill or article · Rate me against candidates it can't see · Talk salary or availability · Remember you between visits
